timeline.message:
Fix partial reduce bug in ip_prefix

This stops us from applying the `min_doc_count` operation on partial
reduction. If run it on partial reduction then we filter out results
that might have more docs arrive.

Closes #89686
timeline.author: Nik Everett

timeline.body:
OK, I see and I understand what is the issue. When we have partial reductions we don't want to filter results based on `min_doc_count` but wait until the final reduction. This way we know how many documents are there in total before filtering based on `min_doc_count`. Otherwise, filtering during partial reduction affects the total number calculated at the end, discarding results that should normally be ok. The following partial reductions might add more documents resulting in a value of doc count that is larger than `min_doc_count`.

LGTM.
